source: Investor Presentation Keyword Directory v3 (task #267 attachment): Part 2, Earnings Call Transcript Keywords (87 keywords in 8 buckets) and Part 3, Results Filing Keywords (101 keywords in 7 buckets), each keyword with its related terms and what to verify, read from the PDF's tables by scripts/build_discovery_sources.py.

Call: Management Guidance & Outlook.verify: Check whether guidance is numeric and time-bound; compare with last quarter's guidance and the delivery record.
Identify what changed (volume, price, mix, order wins) and the assumptions behind the new range.
Separate temporary causes (delays, one-offs) from structural demand or margin problems.
Confirm base year, organic versus acquired growth, and whether past targets were met.
Distinguish aspirational language from board-approved plans backed by capex and funding.
Look for quantified cover (order book to revenue ratio) rather than general comfort statements.
Check conversion history, L1 versus awarded status and bid-to-win ratio.
Name the specific policy or demand driver and size its revenue impact.
Demand evidence of real change in revenue, margin or customer count, not just narrative.
Assess execution risk and compare with the company's historical quarterly split.

Call: Demand, Orders & Customers.verify: Look for volume, order and enquiry data supporting the claim.
Check duration, affected segments and management's recovery timeline.
Split growth into volume, price and mix; price-only growth is less durable.
Verify segment-wise growth and sensitivity to monsoon, inflation and consumer sentiment.
Quantify export share by geography and exposure to tariff or trade-policy changes.
Check percentage of revenue from top customers and contract tenure.
Verify programme, value, start of production and revenue timing.
Look for repeat-order percentage and growth within existing accounts.

Call: Demand, Orders & Customers.keyword: Deal wins and total contract value (TCV)
Call: Demand, Orders & Customers.verify: Separate TCV from annual revenue, and check ramp-up and renewal versus net-new.
Check size of affected orders and likelihood of revenue shifting beyond the year.
Confirm source of market-share data and comparison against peers.
Check productivity per outlet, not just outlet count.

Call: Margins & Profitability.verify: Understand drivers: price, mix, operating leverage, lower input costs or one-offs.
Identify whether cost-driven or competition-driven, and the recovery plan.
Compare incremental margins with average margins across several quarters.
Quantify mix share and margin gap versus the base portfolio.

Call: Margins & Profitability.keyword: Raw material and input cost inflation
Call: Margins & Profitability.verify: Check cost pass-through lag and sensitivity to key commodities.
Verify whether price increases held without volume loss.
Look for quantified savings and sustainability; avoid one-off cost deferrals.
Track unit economics trend across quarters.
Separate operating performance from translation and mark-to-market effects.
Check effect on margin and whether supply of talent constrains growth.
Confirm eligibility, amount recognised, timing of receipt and dependence on the scheme.
Rebuild the underlying run-rate by excluding non-recurring items.

Call: Capex, Capacity & Execution.verify: Split growth and maintenance capex, and check funding mix (internal accruals, debt, equity).
Track announced versus achieved dates for previous projects.
Compare installed capacity to actual production and breakeven levels.

Call: Capex, Capacity & Execution.keyword: Peak revenue potential and asset turn
Call: Capex, Capacity & Execution.verify: Test whether stated revenue potential is consistent with capacity and realisation.
Check revised timeline and cost, plus impact on interest during construction.
Compare execution rate with order book; check revenue recognition method.
Verify capex, stage of completion and expected margin benefit.
Check customer demand, qualification status and policy support.
Distinguish sampling from commercial supply orders.
Look for R&D as a percentage of revenue and the revenue timeline of launches.

Call: Capex, Capacity & Execution.keyword: New product and new market launches
Call: Capex, Capacity & Execution.verify: Verify initial traction metrics such as revenue, repeat rate and distribution.
Verify the signed agreement, royalty terms and commercial milestones.

Call: Balance Sheet, Cash Flow & Capital.verify: Check borrowings including lease liabilities and off-balance-sheet obligations.
Verify targets, interest saved and source of funds.

Call: Balance Sheet, Cash Flow & Capital.keyword: Free cash flow and cash conversion
Call: Balance Sheet, Cash Flow & Capital.verify: Compare operating cash flow with reported profit over several periods.
Check trend in days and movement in receivables from government or large customers.
Check size, pricing, use of proceeds and investor identity.
Compare payout with free cash flow and capex needs.
Trend of returns before and after large capex or acquisitions.
Check if cash is free or earmarked, and whether it supports other income.
Check ageing, provisions and counterparties' payment record.
Track average cost of debt and interest coverage over time.

Call: Balance Sheet, Cash Flow & Capital.keyword: Promoter holding, pledge and stake sale
Call: Balance Sheet, Cash Flow & Capital.verify: Verify filings and use of funds raised by promoters.

Call: Risks, Headwinds & Cautionary Lang.verify: Identify cause, duration and the effect on guidance.
Quantify direct exposure by geography, supply chain or customer.
Check dates for decisions and revenue at risk.
Check effect on realisation, market share and margin.
Identify critical inputs and alternate sources.
Quantify lost production, insurance recovery and timeline to normal.
Check amount, probability of loss and provisions made.
Compare current margin to through-cycle averages.

Call: Risks, Headwinds & Cautionary Lang.keyword: Single product, customer or geography dependence
Call: Risks, Headwinds & Cautionary Lang.verify: Check revenue share of the concentrated exposure.
Treat as a hedge in guidance; look for concrete numbers.
Standard disclaimer; the substance is in the risks management discusses on the call.
Check cost impact and export exposure to carbon-border regimes.

Call: Strategy & Business Model Language.verify: Check capex intensity and return ratios against peers.
Look for user, merchant and transaction metrics to prove scale.
Check for quantified productivity or revenue effect and not just tool deployment.
Verify milestones such as debt reduction, margin recovery and cash generation.
Check appointed date, share-swap ratio and approvals.
Treat as unexecuted until a definitive agreement or filing exists.
Verify share data, pricing power and returns evidence.
Check capital committed and whether management has prior experience.

Call: Strategy & Business Model Language.keyword: China plus one and supply-chain shifts
Call: Strategy & Business Model Language.verify: Look for actual customer orders versus general opportunity statements.
Check filings and continuity of strategy.

related: not in a position to share
Call: Analyst Q&A & Management Language.verify: An undisclosed-information flag; verify through exchange filings.
Check conditions and timeline; do not count unapproved items in estimates.
Treat as unexecuted until a signed agreement or an exchange disclosure.

Call: Analyst Q&A & Management Language.keyword: Early days, pilot and proof of concept
Call: Analyst Q&A & Management Language.verify: Little revenue expected; check scale-up plan and milestones.
Check whether the quarter is representative or a peak or trough.
Compare both views; seasonal businesses need YoY, turnarounds need QoQ.
Ask for a precise figure; ranges can be wide.

Call: Analyst Q&A & Management Language.keyword: Going forward and next few quarters
Call: Analyst Q&A & Management Language.verify: Vague timing; request a specific quarter or date.

Results: Income Statement Line Items.verify: Check composition and growth versus previous periods; confirm the reporting basis.
Check share of PBT and recurrence; high other income can mask weak operations.
Compare with revenue from operations to measure dependence on other income.

related: earnings before interest tax depreciation and amortisation
Results: Income Statement Line Items.verify: Confirm whether other income and exceptional items are included.

related: profit before exceptional items and tax
Results: Income Statement Line Items.verify: Check the effect of exceptional items on the reported figure.
Check attributable versus total profit; verify tax rate effects.
Strip out for run-rate earnings; understand why they recur.
Check share count changes from ESOPs, warrants or conversions.
Compare with debt trend and effective interest rate.
Check for capex commissioning and any change in depreciation policy.
Track employee cost as a percentage of revenue and any ESOP-related charges.
Compute gross margin trend and watch inventory-related swings.
Examine large items and one-off components.
Check effective tax rate against statutory rate and reasons for variation.

Results: Income Statement Line Items.keyword: Share of profit/loss of associates and JVs
related: share of net profit of associates
Results: Income Statement Line Items.verify: Check significance and whether cash returns (dividends) flow to the company.

related: total comprehensive income for the period
Results: Income Statement Line Items.verify: Check large OCI items that move equity but not profit.
Check how much profit belongs to the minority in subsidiaries.
Verify like-for-like comparison with restated or acquired numbers.

Results: Standalone, Consolidated & Segm.verify: Compare with consolidated to see subsidiaries' contribution.
Check consolidation of acquisitions and joint ventures.
Look at segment margins and capital employed, and changes in segment definitions.
Check export share and currency exposure.

related: assets classified as held for sale
Results: Standalone, Consolidated & Segm.verify: Check effect on continuing earnings and restated comparatives.
Check effective date, accounting treatment and restated prior periods.
Review the auditor's report for reservations.
Verify the period and comparative columns match.

Results: Standalone, Consolidated & Segm.keyword: Subsidiaries, associates and joint ventures list
Results: Standalone, Consolidated & Segm.verify: Look for additions and deletions in the group structure during the period.
Understand what changed and whether it flatters current growth.

Results: Balance Sheet & Cash Flow Items.verify: Compare to cash, interest costs and maturity profile.
Check changes from fund raises or large write-offs.

Results: Balance Sheet & Cash Flow Items.keyword: Trade receivables and expected credit loss
Results: Balance Sheet & Cash Flow Items.verify: Check ageing, provisioning and concentration of overdue accounts.
Check inventory days versus revenue growth and any write-downs.
Check size relative to gross block and capitalisation timeline.
Check goodwill as a percentage of net worth and impairment risk.
Check restricted balances and liquidity versus short-term debt.
Compare with PAT and EBITDA for earnings quality.

Results: Balance Sheet & Cash Flow Items.keyword: Cash flow from investing and financing
Results: Balance Sheet & Cash Flow Items.verify: Check capex versus guidance and the way growth is funded.
Check size relative to net worth and likelihood of crystallisation.
Include in debt-like obligations for leverage comparisons.
Contract liabilities and advances are a lead indicator of future revenue.

Results: Auditor Report & Quality Flags.verify: Read for any qualification or other-matter paragraphs.
A major red flag; check the item, amount and management response.
Check issue (litigation, uncertainty, delays in compliance) and its financial impact.
Identify areas of highest audit risk.
Critical risk flag; verify liquidity, debt defaults and funding plans.
Check reasons given and timing relative to results.
Check size and cause; frequent restatements reduce reliability.
Check the effect on earnings and comparability.

Results: Auditor Report & Quality Flags.keyword: Fraud, forensic audit and CARO remarks
Results: Auditor Report & Quality Flags.verify: Read details and amounts; check regulatory follow-up.
Check the auditor's comments on adequacy and operating effectiveness.
Assess size relative to revenue and approvals obtained.
A governance warning sign; check reasons and penalties.

Results: Regulatory Filings & Corporate.verify: Read the outcome filing for decisions beyond results (fund raise, M&A, capex).
Check payout ratio against earnings and cash flow.
Check size, premium to market price and funding source.
Corporate action only; no value change itself, but check intent and liquidity effect.

Results: Regulatory Filings & Corporate.keyword: Fund raising: QIP, preferential and rights
Results: Regulatory Filings & Corporate.verify: Check pricing, dilution, investor list and use of proceeds.

Results: Regulatory Filings & Corporate.keyword: NCD, debentures and commercial paper issue
Results: Regulatory Filings & Corporate.verify: Check tenure, coupon, security and refinancing need.
Check dilution and cost recognised in the income statement.
Read rationale; rating changes often precede borrowing cost changes.

Results: Regulatory Filings & Corporate.keyword: Change in directors and key managerial personnel
Results: Regulatory Filings & Corporate.verify: Check reasons given; independent director exits with allegations are red flags.
Check percentage pledged, lender and any invocation.
Check quarterly changes and concentration of holders.
Check consideration, valuation and closing conditions.
Confirm value, counterparty, execution period and binding status.
Check amount, forum, and whether the company is contesting.

Results: Regulatory Filings & Corporate.keyword: Fire, outage and force majeure disclosure
Results: Regulatory Filings & Corporate.verify: Check estimated impact and insurance cover.
Check approved amount, funding and timeline.

Results: Regulatory Filings & Corporate.keyword: Earnings call and analyst meet intimation
Results: Regulatory Filings & Corporate.verify: Use to locate the call transcript and presentation that match the results.
Closures often precede results; useful for timing only.

Results: Regulatory Filings & Corporate.keyword: Name change, object clause or MOA/AOA change
Results: Regulatory Filings & Corporate.verify: A change in objects can signal a new business direction.

Results: Regulatory Filings & Corporate.keyword: Delisting, open offer and takeover code
Results: Regulatory Filings & Corporate.verify: Check offer price, trigger and acceptance conditions.
Review resolutions for related-party approvals and capital raising.

Results: Press Release & Investor Highli.verify: Compare with the prior peak and check whether it was a one-off.
Check the base period used for comparison.

related: order book position at period end
Results: Press Release & Investor Highli.verify: Confirm the date and whether it includes letters of intent.

Results: Press Release & Investor Highli.keyword: Net debt to equity and net debt to EBITDA
Results: Press Release & Investor Highli.verify: Verify definition, including or excluding lease liabilities.
Track volume growth separately from price.
Compare with installed capacity and breakeven.

Results: Press Release & Investor Highli.keyword: Cash profit and operating cash flow

Results: Press Release & Investor Highli.verify: Use highlights to locate what the company wants to emphasise, then test against full results.
Cross-check with the earnings call for numbers.
Check commercial significance and sales timeline.

Results: Sector-Specific KPIs Reported i.verify: Look for sustainability against rate cycle and funding mix.
Compare growth with industry and funding stability.
Check quality of growth and collection efficiency.
Check headroom relative to regulatory minimum and growth plans.
Check margin sustainability and product mix.
Compare growth and margin with peers and check large-deal concentration.
Track ARPU growth and subscriber quality.
Separate growth from store additions from same-store growth.
Look at collections and launches, not just bookings.
Check occupancy trend and unit economics.
Check contracted share of capacity and receivable days from discoms.
Check execution speed and receivables from public clients.
Check inspection outcomes and concentration in a few molecules or customers.
Distinguish OEM schedule commitments from actual production.
Check commodity sensitivity and cost position.
